data.body: Patchset 2 pushed. Fixes: CI Verified-1 was the ADR-number bijection gate (missing docs/adr/.numbers/0103 marker) — added. Also folded in LLM-Review advisory findings: coerce non-str diagnostic messages before redaction, redact all admitted string diagnostic keys (defense-in-depth), derive overflow sentinel counts from _MAX_DIAGNOSTICS, and fail loud on unrecognized decide_replay observations. Suite now 47 tests (8 new, teeth-checked). lint+typecheck+complexity+ADR gates all green locally. Awaiting re-vote.
